NOTICE UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS ACT, No. 44 OF 1980 ASAMENDED BY THE REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS)ACT, No. 10 OF 2017
No. and Name of Electoral District 11 - Vanni

NOTICE is hereby given under Section 4 of the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980 as amended by the Registrationof Electors (Special Provisions) Act, No. 10 of 2017 that the supplementary register 2018 of internally displaced electorsrelating to the above mentioned electoral district was certified and is being exhibited at the District Elections Office,Mullaitivu during office hours for perusal.
D. C. ARAVINTHARAJ,Assistant Registering Officer,Electoral District 11 - Vanni.Elections Office,Mullaitivu,16th November 2018.
